description: Pairs on which each evaluated model produced the intended baseline verdicts in our runs (P_safe > 0.5 for the safe input, P_safe < 0.5 for the unsafe input, gap > 1e-8), using the safety-classifier instruction given in the README and the first answer token's Yes/No probabilities. For the text subset a pair must additionally pass the tokenizer check (equal token count, exactly one differing model token). These are the pairs used in the activation-patching and direction-intervention experiments of the paper; they are provided for reproducibility and are model-specific, not part of the dataset labels.
